report.title: # Context report
report.latestMeaning: Occupancy uses the latest reported context measurement, not session totals. When no authoritative context total is reported, the estimate includes latest prompt input, cache tokens and reported output. Input billing may aggregate multiple requests in the latest turn. No session aggregate is available in this report.
report.output: Reported output (shown separately; do not add again): {tokens}
report.externalCompact: The external agent has not reported its compaction policy here. A known window does not establish its threshold or enabled state.
report.compactDisabled: Local auto-compaction is configured off. The threshold below is a configuration estimate, not an active trigger.
report.compactEstimate: Local configuration is an estimate, not live SDK policy. SDK live policy, when reported, takes precedence.
report.cacheMissing: Cache telemetry was not reported; this is not a measured zero hit rate.
report.cacheMeaning: Absent fields remain unknown; explicit zero is preserved. TTL writes are subdivisions of cache writes, not additional occupancy. These request counters are not independently additive to live context occupancy.
report.promptLength: Configured system prompt length: {count} characters (content omitted)
report.configuredNotLoaded: Directories and loading mode are configuration only. They do not prove a skill is loaded or quantify its context cost; see SDK inventory when available.
report.builtinTools: Configured built-in tools: {categories} enabled categories / {tools} catalog tools. Configuration does not establish runtime availability or loading; see /tools for details.

sdk.title: ## Live context (SDK)
sdk.compactUnknown: Live compaction threshold: not reported / unknown
sdk.overlap: Categories and the detailed inventories below overlap. Do not add their subtotals together. Deferred entries are definitions not yet occupying context; unknown loading states are not assumed loaded.
sdk.deferredInventory: deferred inventory; do not add to occupancy

controller.title: Context details
controller.noSession: No live session. Below are local configuration and available telemetry; missing occupancy is not zero.
controller.unsupported: This backend does not expose an SDK category breakdown through this interface. Below are its reported usage and local configuration, which do not prove every configured item is loaded.
controller.unavailable: Live breakdown unavailable. The latest usage and local configuration remain available below.
controller.timeout: The live breakdown request timed out. Latest usage and local configuration are shown below; run /context again to retry.
controller.help: This is a point-in-time snapshot. ↑/↓ scroll, PgUp/PgDn page, / search, g/G first/last, Esc back. Run /context again to refresh; /compact requests conversation compaction.
